description: Header file defining a template class for generating complex normal (Gaussian) random numbers, including parameter management and distribution methods.

classes.name: complex_normal_distribution
classes.description: Template class for generating complex normal distributed random numbers with configurable mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates the next random complex number in the distribution, optionally with a different parameter set.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the distribution.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: stddev
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of the distribution.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Returns or sets the distribution's parameter set.
